high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the official Twitter account of Narendra Modi (@narendramodi). The tweet is dated 6 minutes prior to the screenshot being taken. The content of the tweet reads: "I have been getting many requests from citizens across India to name the Khel Ratna Award after Major Dhyan Chand. I thank them for their views. Respecting their sentiment, the Khel Ratna Award will hereby be called the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award! Jai Hind! The tweet includes a hashtag "
